reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact intervention, mechanism, and predicted outcome already demonstrated in P3, P4, P5, and P6 for (FeCoNiMnCu)Pt, merely substituting the base alloy from FeCoNiMnCu to FeCoNi. It proposes no new material, regime, or mechanistic insight beyond what those passages report as an accomplished result.
copied_elements: Adding ~50 at.% Pt to a FeCoNi-based HEA thin film
Post-deposition RTA to promote L1₀ ordering
L1₀ ordering reduces crystal symmetry and introduces strong spin-orbit coupling
Enhanced magnetocrystalline anisotropy and domain wall pinning
Coercivity increase by orders of magnitude (3 orders in P3, P5)
Sputtered thin films on Si/SiO₂ substrates
XRD for phase identification and VSM for magnetic hysteresis
